description: This file defines the configuration state and parsing logic for Talk Mode Gateway in a Swift-based project. It includes a data structure for the state and a parser with static methods to construct this state from a configuration snapshot, considering various environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses configuration snapshot to produce a TalkModeGatewayConfigState, determining active provider, voice settings, API keys, and other parameters based on preferences, environment, and defaults.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides a default configuration state for Talk Mode Gateway when specific configuration is missing, using environment variables and default values.
